title: Computation of the multiplicities of zigzags
summary: In this note, we explore various cohomological invariants on double complexes with the aim of finding their decomposition into irreducible parts, which are of square and zigzag shape. By studying the growth rate of the number of invariants given by the multiplicities of zigzags in the double complex of an n-dimensional complex manifold, we show that the De Rham, Dolbeault, Bott-Chern, Aeppli, and Varouchas cohomologies do not suffice to distinguish non-isomorphic double complexes.
